newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet trade spreads stable, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet trade spreads stable, trade inactive.

text.p: NWE jet fuel differentials were notionally steady on Tuesday but business was inactive, traders said.
"It's the longest period of inactivity on jet that I can remember," said one market player.
Barges fob ARA and cargo differentials cif NWE were seen around parity at September IPE +$17.
EU qualified material again was notionally $7 over fob Med high quotations. Non-EU qualified product was $5 or $6 over the quotations.
